V. 39.
An adulterous generation—Whoſe Heart wanders from GOD tho' they profeſs Him to be their Huſband. Such Adulterers are all thoſe who love the World, and all who ſeek the Friendſhip of it. Seeketh a ſign—After all they have had all already, which were abundantly ſufficient to convince them, had not their Hearts been eſtranged from GOD, and conſequently averſe to the Truth. The ſign of Jonah—Who Who was herein a Type of Chriſt
